title: JACKETEK SIZE M DEVELOPMENT SAMPLE REQUEST
documentType: Development sample request — NOT a Production Tech Pack, NOT a customer RFQ

sources.masterRevision: v0.2 — measurement source matrix: per-POM source evidence, provisional M targets per POM, method definitions, sample plan; K2 materials / construction plan, PARTIALLY RESOLVED (no value approved; v0.1 statuses and provenance kept)

workflow: JACKETEK sends this M Development Sample Request (MSR) to the factory.
Factory / pattern maker reviews the target silhouette and the open construction requirements.
Factory proposes the missing material and construction specifications.
Pattern maker establishes the missing pattern-dependent dimensions (incl. SC-1 to SC-3).
Factory makes the physical size-M sample.
Factory measures the finished sample by the JACKETEK POM methods in this document.
Factory returns: measurement sheet, material specification sheet, construction proposal, photos, the sample.
JACKETEK compares the actual measurements with the provisional targets.
Only after approval does JACKETEK create Production Tech Pack v1.0.

droppedShoulder.shoulderPoint: On the JACKETEK garment the shoulder point (SP) is where the sleeve-attachment (armhole) seam line crosses the shoulder line — the shoulder seam extended to the top fold with the garment laid flat. It sits below and outside the wearer's natural shoulder; its exact position is set by the pattern maker.

zoneSchedule.label: REFERENCE FOR PLACEMENT — NOT PHYSICAL SIZE
zoneSchedule.rule: Shares of garment landmarks, not measurements. No zone is converted to cm in this document; the conversion is done by JACKETEK after the M sample is measured.

calibration.title: EMBROIDERY ZONE CALIBRATION — TO COMPLETE FROM M SAMPLE

measurements.measure: Mark both HPS points (shoulder seam meets collar seam); photograph with a ruler.
Vertical, parallel to CF, from HPS to the top of the waistband rib (waistband seam), each side.
Vertical, parallel to CB, from HPS to the waistband seam. Also equals B07 − R01.
Straight along the waistband seam, side to side (flat). Same as B03 flat width.

measurements.landmark: Waistband seam height at CF, side seam and CB
measurements.measure: Distance of the waistband seam above the finished edge at CF, side and CB (shows if the seam is level).
Placket inner stitch line to CF (F01, F02); the chest zones must stay clear of the placket and snaps.
At the chest-zone level: CF → armhole seam (each side); collar seam → top of pocket opening; pocket position (P03, P04).
Shoulder seams / armhole seams to CB at 3 levels (top, middle, above the waistband); any back seam or yoke.
Mark both shoulder points (armhole seam on the shoulder line); photograph; B09 and B10.
S02 primary (along the overarm). The sleeve zones are shares of this length.
Sleeve flat width, perpendicular to the sleeve line, every 5 cm from the shoulder point to the cuff seam.
Position of every sleeve seam (underarm seam, back-sleeve seam if any) and leather panel joins on the outer face, from the overarm fold.

For each zone, mark with removable tape the largest area clear of seams, placket, snaps, pockets, collar and rib (plus the factory's safety margin); measure its width × height and its position from the landmarks above; photograph with a ruler.

calibration.conversion: Not performed. JACKETEK converts the normalised zones to cm after these measurements are returned.
